coverage.reason: States that one class can bear costs attributable to another. It gives both directions: mutual fund redemptions burden ETF holders, and ETF creation/redemption costs burden mutual fund holders. It covers trading costs, cash drag and gains.

Gives a concrete mechanism for each direction. Mutual fund cash redemptions cause trading costs, taxable gains and cash drag borne partly by ETF holders. ETF creation/redemption costs not recovered through transaction fees burden mutual fund holders. It also covers the optional points on netting against fees and on in-kind low-basis removal as a benefit ('not automatically an improper subsidy'). All of this is labeled as conceptual examples.
